## ZJK Secures Large-Volume Purchase Orders for AI Infrastructure Components


August 24, 2026


[PDF Version](https://ir.zjk-industrial.com/node/7091/pdf)


SHENZHEN, China, Aug. 24, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- ZJK Industrial Co., Ltd. (NASDAQ: ZJK) (“ZJK” or the “Company”), a high-tech precision parts and hardware manufacturer serving artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure, consumer electronics, electric vehicles, aerospace and other smart technologies, today announced that the Company has secured large-volume purchase orders for AI infrastructure components from several major customers.


The Company believes that these orders reflect customers’ recognition of ZJK’s R&D capabilities, manufacturing quality and delivery reliability in AI infrastructure components, and are expected to further strengthen the business cooperation with these customers within the AI server hardware industry. ZJK is rapidly expanding its production capacity for the relevant products to address customer demand. The Company has commenced deliveries under the purchase orders, which are currently proceeding in accordance with the applicable delivery schedules.


With the continuous iteration of large language models, the power consumption of next-generation AI chips has exceeded the kilowatt level, and liquid cooling has evolved from an optional solution in data centers to a standard requirement for high-density AI computing infrastructure. Against this backdrop, the global AI liquid cooling market is expected to continue expanding rapidly in the years ahead, which the Company believes will drive demand for liquid cooling quick connectors and other high-value precision metal structural components.


ZJK’s management stated, “We believe the AI infrastructure components market offers strong long-term growth visibility over the next three to five years. Investment in new AI computing infrastructure and the retrofit of existing data centers will continue to drive demand for precision structural components. Securing orders from major players in the AI server hardware assembly industry validates ZJK’s capabilities. Going forward, we will continue to expand our dedicated liquid cooling production lines and increase R&D investment in related precision metal structural components, positioning us to capitalize on this market opportunity and drive sustained growth in our AI hardware business.”


**About ZJK Industrial Co., Ltd.**
ZJK Industrial Co., Ltd. is a high-tech precision parts and hardware manufacturer serving artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure, consumer electronics, electric vehicles, aerospace, and other smart technologies. With over 15 years in the precision metal parts manufacturing industry, the Company maintains a skilled professional team, a series of highly automated and precision manufacturing equipment, a stable and diversified customer base, and comprehensive quality management systems. ZJK mainly offers standard screws, precision screws and nuts, high-strength bolts and nuts, turning parts, stamping parts, and Computer Numerical Control (CNC) machining parts, CNC milling parts, high precision structural components, Surface Mounting Technology (SMT) for miniature parts packaging, and technology service for research and development from a professional engineering team.
